instructions.value: Participants were asked to identify the category of the presented object, make perceptual guesses, or spontaneously and freely choose either “piano” or “chair”.

spans.text: Participants were asked to spontaneously and freely choose either “piano” or “chair”, whatever category came first to their minds.

stimuli.value: Pictures of pianos and chairs, strongly masked noise images, and fixation crosses.

spans.text: The stimuli were 24 pictures of pianos and chairs, created from freely available pictures from the Internet or custom-made photographs, showing objects in different natural backgrounds.
